free_tier_limits.correction: Not applicable: libretranslate.com offers no free trial or free low-volume API key; self-hosting remains free.

rate_limits.correction: Pro permits bursts up to 80 translations per minute; Business permits up to 200 translations per minute. Higher custom limits are available.

cors.correction: yes; the API implementation adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and permits GET and POST.

notes: The official hosted endpoint is operational and its request example is current. The material errors concern service terms: libretranslate.com has no free API tier, publishes paid-plan burst limits, and the current implementation explicitly emits CORS headers. Free use refers to self-hosting or separate community instances, not the official hosted API.
